title: Frugal coloring of graphs revisited
summary: Given a graph $G$ and a positive integer $t$, an independent set $S\subseteq V(G)$ is $t$-frugal if every vertex has at most $t$ neighbors in $S$. A $t$-frugal coloring of $G$ is a partition of its vertex set into $t$-frugal independent sets. The maximum cardinality of a $t$-frugal independent set in $G$ is denoted by $α_t^f(G)$, while the minimum cardinality of a $t$-frugal coloring of $G$, $χ_t^f(G)$, is called the $t$-frugal chromatic number of $G$.
